description.value: Summerland Arena is a publicly operated multi-sport indoor facility managed by the District of Summerland, hosting ice skating, curling, ice hockey, broomball, and lacrosse. It is a community hub for local sport in the South Okanagan. Touring cyclists passing through Summerland may find it a useful landmark, but it functions primarily as a local sports venue rather than a cycling-oriented attraction.
